unresolved.finding: Command arguments are read into a fixed 100-character buffer without length or status handling, so longer arguments are silently truncated.
Unknown command-line options are silently ignored, and multiple informational options are all processed rather than terminating after the first recognized request.
Every return code after readinput is overwritten without inspection, so initialization, parameter lookup, step, output, or finalization failures cannot stop or alter the driver.
If either getdoubleparameter call fails, the ignored status leaves t or tstop potentially undefined before the main-loop comparison.
The main loop has no guard that executestep successfully advances t, so a failed or zero-timestep step can run forever because its status is ignored.

The XBeach grid branch decides whether a depth file is required from par%hotstart before the hotstart parameter is read from params.txt, so a requested hotstart can follow stale/default state and unnecessarily require or load depfile.

Critical positive quantities including dx, dy, dtheta, dtheta_s, tstop, gravity, and wave periods are read without strict=.true., so zero or negative out-of-range values only warn and can later drive divisions, invalid extents, or nonterminating angle normalization.
Delft3D mmax and nmax are converted directly to nx=mmax-1 and ny=nmax-1 without validating minimum or maximum grid sizes before downstream allocation and boundary indexing.
The dynamicroughness lookup embeds a trailing blank in the key literal, unlike the externally documented spelling and neighboring lookups, relying on blank-padding equality for recognition.
maxcf and mincf are read independently without enforcing mincf<=maxcf, permitting an inverted clamp interval.
The slopecorr parmapply call stores its selected option string into par%sedfricfac_str, overwriting the sediment-friction description instead of a slope-correction field.
morstart and morstop are bounded independently but never checked for morstop>=morstart, allowing an inverted morphology interval.
tint, tintg, tintp, tintm, and tinth use strict lower bounds of zero, allowing zero intervals that timestep_init later uses as divisors when generating schedules.
Every posdwn value below 0.1, including allowed small positive values, is coerced to -1 while other positive magnitudes remain unnormalized, making this nominal sign option behave discontinuously.
The tide auto-epsi branch tests epsi<-1 even though the configured default is exactly -1, so the documented automatic path is not entered at the default sentinel.
The warning text says wave-current interaction with non-stationary waves is experimental, but the condition emits it only for the stationary wave model.

Post-processing unconditionally reads tintg, tintp, tintm, tinth, wavint, morfac, morstart, morstop, and rt although several are assigned in all_input only under feature-specific branches, leaving correctness dependent on hidden defaults in the generated parameter declaration.

distribute_par broadcasts raw sizeof(par) bytes for a non-C-interoperable Fortran derived type containing pointer descriptors, copying process-local addresses and compiler-dependent representation across ranks before repairing only selected pointers.
The documented/default nglobalvar limit is 20, but the default global-output branch writes 21 names and sets nglobalvar=21, creating an inconsistent public count contract.

readOutputStrings searches parameter keys with exact case and without strippedline normalization even though the main readkey parser is case-insensitive, so inputs accepted for the count can fail when their following variable list is located.
Output-list and point-position readers open hard-coded unit 10 rather than obtaining a free unit, risking collision with another connected file.

readPointPosition searches indefinitely with external READ statements that have no iostat, so a missing or differently cased count keyword terminates on raw end-of-file instead of reporting a controlled input error.

When bcast is false, all scalar and vector readers assign results only on xmaster, so non-master callers receive undefined function results despite the routines remaining publicly callable on all ranks.
readkey_dbl parses through fixed F10.0 format, so only a ten-character field is consumed and longer valid floating-point values can be truncated or rejected.
readkey_str maps old option j to allowed(j) without requiring nov<=nv, while the independent allowed/old-name setup APIs permit more old names than allowed names.
The vector readers never require 0<=vlength<=tlength, directly section value_vec(1:vlength), and leave result elements vlength+1:tlength undefined.

Both vector readers handle only negative internal-read iostat, so a positive iostat from an invalid token is ignored and partially undefined elements are subsequently range-checked, logged, and returned.
readkey stores every line containing '=' into fixed 1024-element keyword/value arrays without checking ikey before incrementing, so a larger parameter file writes out of bounds.
The parameter cache is invalidated only when the filename string changes, so rereading a modified file under the same name returns stale values and stale used-key tracking.
readkey uses hard-coded unit 99 for both passes and does not check OPEN status, risking unit collisions and unstructured failures for inaccessible files.
parmapply assigns optional parm_str only on xmaster and never broadcasts it, so a present parm_str is undefined on non-master ranks even when parameter broadcasting is enabled.
parmapply indexes allowednames(idefname) without checking idefname against 1:numallowednames.
setallowednames tests only each optional name aN before dereferencing the independently optional value vN, so legal calls that omit a paired value reference an absent optional argument.
read_v_9 assumes optional outputs are present contiguously; presence of a higher-numbered argument causes all lower arguments to be read and broadcast even if some were omitted via keywords.
The read_v overloads perform external reads without iostat handling, so malformed or short records bypass the module's structured error reporting.
strippedline replaces every byte outside printable 7-bit ASCII with a blank, silently corrupting valid non-ASCII parameter values and filenames.
parameter pointer components have no default NULL() association, leaving unused components undefined or stale across descriptor reuse.

Every getkey result of a given type points to one module-saved scratch scalar, so a later call silently changes the value observed through all earlier descriptors and the routine is not reentrant or thread-safe.
Successful getkey calls set only name, rank, type, and one value pointer, leaving the public units, description, dimensions, and nonselected pointer fields undefined or inherited from a previous use.

arraytype's mutually exclusive pointer components have no default NULL() initialization, so newly declared descriptors contain undefined association status for every component not explicitly set by generated mapping code.
chartoindex reports an unknown name only by logging and returns -1 as an ordinary index, leaving callers able to subscript arrays with that invalid value.
dimensions is given both a DIMENSION(maxrank) attribute and an entity array specification (20), a duplicate shape declaration that standard-conforming Fortran rejects.
arrayf2c always returns c_loc(a) for a local three-element temporary rather than the requested farray storage, and that pointer becomes invalid when the function returns.
stringlength never exits on a null character and then unconditionally overwrites every detected position with size(char_array), so it always returns the full array size.
The collected and precollected flags have no default initialization in the type definition even though collection logic reads collected(index) to decide whether to skip work.
All exported computational range bounds lack initial values, so any use before ranges_init receives undefined indices.
index_allocate and index_allocated do not validate index as indextos does, and an invalid index can silently no-op or be reported allocated because the default result is true.
index_allocate unconditionally takes choice(1:1), which is invalid for a zero-length actual argument, and silently ignores nonempty unsupported choices.
space_distribute_vector treats every xy value other than lowercase 'x' as a y distribution, while space_distribute_block_vector accepts only lowercase 'y' and aborts for all other values.

The MPI decomposition subtracts fixed two-cell borders and immediately allocates local state without checking that every lm and ln is large enough, so an over-decomposed small grid can produce inverted computational ranges.
space_who_has returns the undocumented sentinel -123 when a point has no owning computational region and provides no status or diagnostic.
space_collect_index uses index directly in sg%collected before indextos can validate it, and space_collect_mnem passes through chartoindex results without checking for an unknown mnemonic.
For real rank-1 arrays and unsupported real ranks/types, space_collect_index performs no collection yet still marks sg%collected(index) true, suppressing future attempts.
gridprops assumes nx>=1 throughout and requires nx>=2 to define alfaz from an interior point; with nx=1 its two boundary-copy assignments merely circulate an uninitialized orientation.
gridprops inverts computed cell areas, and in 1D products of metrics, without rejecting zero-area or repeated-coordinate cells, producing infinite geometric factors.
ranges_init can produce lower bounds greater than upper bounds for small global or local nx/ny values, with no validation before those ranges are consumed by array sections and reductions.
posdwn is transformed to posdwn*abs(posdwn), so any value other than exactly -1, 0, or 1 unexpectedly rescales bathymetry rather than merely enforcing a sign convention.

For setbathy==1 the initial depth read is skipped, and for XBeach-format hotstart==1 it is also skipped, yet zb is sent, negated, boundary-copied, copied to zb0, and used for slopes before the later bathymetry/hotstart loaders define it.
The Delft3D comment-skip loop tests line(1:1) without first handling a nonzero read iostat, so EOF after comment lines can leave the previous '*' line in place and loop indefinitely.
The Delft3D branch skips the depth file for setbathy but not for hotstart, unlike the XBeach-format branch, causing a hotstart run to require and read a depth file that will be replaced.
Boundary copies assume nx>=1 and slope calculations divide by dsu/dnv without checking positive nonzero grid metrics.
dtheta and dtheta_s are used as divisors without validation and rounded counts can become zero, after which allocations and sigm=sum(...)/ntheta operate on an invalid or empty angular grid.

setbathy_init accepts nonpositive or unsorted nsetbathy/time values without validation, allowing an empty schedule to silently initialize every bathymetry value to zero or a nonmonotonic schedule to violate linear_interp's ordering contract.
wave_init allocates Dp, umwci, vmwci, zswci, and fw-related wave state but does not initialize Dp or the three WCI arrays before returning.
Wave intrinsic frequency is computed as 2*pi/Trep without a local positive-period guard for boundary types that do not force Trep to 10.
spectral_wave_init opens and reads the boundary file header without iostat handling, so missing or malformed input can fail outside the routine's structured logging path.

flow_init leaves several allocated arrays without initialization, including qmag, dUi, dVi, cfu, cfv, zs1, sigz, uz, vz, ustz, and nutz, creating an implicit requirement that every consumer wait for another producer.

Although hotstart zs, uu, and vv are deliberately preserved during allocation and initial zeroing, flow_init later unconditionally resets uu and vv and all derived flow quantities to zero, discarding the loaded hotstart velocities.
The hotstartflow fixed-point solver divides by s%cf immediately after flow_init explicitly sets s%cf to zero, and its convergence loop has no iteration cap or nonfinite-value exit.

For a completely wet domain under instant tide, the intended interpolation branch contains only comments and leaves both zs0fac weights zero everywhere, suppressing offshore and bay tide contributions.
sed_init returns with several allocated arrays uninitialized, including Tsg, vmag, vreps, vrepb, iwl, ccz, ca, and refA (and D15 when dilatancy is disabled).
Sediment layer assignments use nd_var and, in the single-grain case, forcibly set nd_var=2 without ensuring nd is at least two or that nd_var lies within 1:nd.
Multi-grain initialization normalizes any positive-sum fractions without rejecting individual negative fractions, so physically invalid negative bed composition can survive normalization.
For a line discharge classified in the v direction on a ny=0 grid, n1 is clamped down to zero and stored as a grid index.

Drifter positions are converted to integer indices by implicit truncation after metric division and are never clamped to the grid, so offsets outside the nearest cell or zero metrics can yield invalid indices.

All low-level hotstart readers capture open and per-row read iostat values but never test them, so fixed-format mismatches or I/O failures can silently leave restart arrays partially undefined despite the earlier list-directed length check.
timestep_init initializes the other counters and output flags but omits tpar%ith and tpar%outputh, which are subsequently read and incremented by outputtimes_update.
Generated schedules divide by wavint/tintg/tintp/tintm/tinth and allocate from the result without local checks for zero, negative, or otherwise invalid intervals and time ranges.
File-supplied schedule counts are read as real values, rounded with nint, and used as allocation extents without rejecting negative, nonintegral, or unreasonable counts.
All schedule files are opened on hard-coded unit 10 without checking whether that unit is already connected.

For duplicate scheduled times, each output counter advances only once while tnext excludes all times equal to the current time, leaving the counter pinned on the duplicate and preventing that output category from matching later times.

Current-output tests follow each array's counter order while next-time selection takes a masked minval over the full array, so unsorted file schedules can be stepped to without being emitted and counters can become permanently misaligned.

timestep's saved dtref has no explicit initial value and compute_dt initializes it only when it happens to equal zero or enters a t<=0 branch, making calls that begin at positive time depend on undefined saved state.
compute_dt returns before assigning present ierr or limtypeout when xcompute is false.

The cold-start timestep divides by sqrt(maxval(hh)*g) without a positive lower bound, despite the branch comment explicitly anticipating zero initialization, so an all-zero depth field yields an infinite or invalid timestep.

Several active stability expressions take square roots of hu/hv and divide by spacing-derived sums without guarding negative depths or zero cell metrics, allowing NaN or zero-division results to contaminate timestep selection.

In the 1D viscosity criterion mdx is a squared spacing but positive par%dy is assigned to mdy without squaring, unlike the 2D branch, producing a dimensionally inconsistent and incorrect stability limit.
Bed-celerity and sediment-diffusion reductions of par%dt do not update ilim, jlim, limtype, or dtold, so instability diagnostics can attribute the limiting timestep to an earlier criterion.
Groundwater stability calculations divide directly by par%kx and par%ky without local positivity checks when their respective branches are enabled.

The MPI path skips angular wave limiting when ntheta<=1, whereas the serial path applies it for every nonstationary model, potentially forcing a zero or spurious dt from a meaningless dtheta in the single-direction case.
timestep itself returns before defining a present INTENT(OUT) ierr when xcompute is false.
check_file_exist performs the inquiry only on xmaster without broadcasting error, so a present exist output is always reported true on non-master ranks regardless of the file's existence.

The three check_file_length variants do not validate extents or capture allocation/open errors, so bad dimensions or an inaccessible file can trigger a raw runtime failure before their intended read-error reporting.
checkbcfilelength does not assign filetype for wbctype values outside its enumerated branches, yet immediately selects on filetype, whose dummy argument has no declared intent or local default.
A LOCLIST file containing only its header produces nlocs=0 and skips all boundary-duration validation, allowing a positive-duration simulation to pass this check without any boundary file.

get_file_length opens hard-coded unit 11 without checking whether it is already connected, unlike the module's own free-unit allocator, risking interference with unrelated open files or an open failure.
get_file_length does not capture OPEN errors and treats every nonzero READ iostat as ordinary end-of-file, so malformed numeric input is silently reported as a shorter file.

create_new_fid_generic's initialized local tryunit has implicit SAVE and only decreases across calls, so closed units are never reconsidered and the allocator eventually reports exhaustion after enough cumulative opens even when nearly all units are free.
linear_interp_2d does not require nx and ny to be positive before applying reductions and using the resulting indices to access X, Y, and Z.
mkmap accepts n2 without validation but initializes search positions to one and calls hunt on zero-length arrays when n2 is zero, where hunt reads xx(n) and xx(1).
mkmap never initializes covered, so any target not processed as lying in a source cell retains undefined or caller-supplied status despite the documented default of zero.
make_map declares covered INTENT(OUT) but never initializes entries for targets not found in any source cell, leaving those output elements undefined.
Both mapping routines ignore bilin5's ier and copy hbuff even though bilin5 exits on several error paths without defining its INTENT(OUT) weight array, while also marking the target covered.
Both mapping routines explicitly round double-precision interpolation weights to real kind 4 before storing them back into double-precision w.

mkmap_step divides by dsu and dnv without zero checks and applies unrestricted floor offsets without ensuring the updated i1,j1 still identify a valid cell, so it can emit invalid flattened references.

grmap and grmap2 validate references only as positive (and grmap only gates on the first reference), so references greater than n1 directly index f1 and zero or negative later grmap references are silently redirected to f1(1).
ipon reduces translated double-precision polygon coordinates to real kind 4 before edge and crossing tests, making containment results lose precision and depend on absolute coordinate scale.
sort calls indexx for n=0, for which indexx reaches indx(0) and arrin(indx(0)) rather than returning on an empty input.
bilin5 leaves its INTENT(OUT) w array undefined whenever it returns ier=1, making even correct error-aware callers unable to rely on a deterministic failure value.
trapezoidal double-counts a full grid-cell contribution when both limits lie in the same cell or adjacent cells because Imid is formed even when there is no middle interval.
trapezoidal assumes n>=2, nonzero ascending spacing, ordered limits, and equidistance but validates none of these before division and index calculation.
trapezoidal_cyclic reads x(2), divides by dx, and indexes xp(1) and xp(np) without guarding n<2, zero spacing, reversed limits, or a resulting nonpositive np.
interp_using_trapez_rule unconditionally reads xtarg(2) and divides by the inferred spacing, so ntarg<2 or equal first targets cause bounds or divide-by-zero failures.
interp_in_cyclic_function's n>icycle+1 branch contains only a comment and leaves xc and yc uninitialized before they are used.
A zero, negative, or incompatible dx/xcycle can make icycle nonpositive, leading to invalid allocations and wrapping loops that cannot progress because they add or subtract icycle.

The interpolation fraction uses mod(xp,dx)/dx without subtracting the grid origin and uses sign-preserving mod for negative coordinates, so shifted grids or negative query coordinates can receive incorrect or extrapolative weights even though indices are cyclically wrapped.

fftn neither rejects nor reports zero, duplicate, or out-of-range dim entries (and silently truncates an oversized dim array), allowing invalid shape indexing, repeated transforms, or a zero-length normalization product.
fftradix returns for npass <= 1 without defining its INTENT(OUT) optional stat, after which fftn reads that undefined value when stat is present.
When a present dim array has size zero, fftn performs no fftradix call and returns without ever defining its INTENT(OUT) stat argument.
The products of caller-provided shape values are computed in default integer without validation, so nonpositive or overflowing extents can produce invalid scaling and assumed-size array traversal.
hilbert accepts m without validation, and m <= 0 reaches log(real(m)) and subsequent invalid exponent/allocation/index calculations.
hilbert declares xi complex but deliberately initializes the transform from only real(xi), silently discarding any input imaginary component without documenting that xi must represent real data.
hilbert computes both normalization factors through default-real real(n) and sqrt rather than fftkind precision.

flipa's flip==1 branch loops to M1 while indexing the second dimension temp3a(:,ii) and M1+1-ii, so a nonsquare M1-by-M2 array can be indexed out of bounds or only partly assigned and the branch does not actually reverse the first dimension.
random applies iabs to an unrestricted default integer seed, for which the most-negative representable integer is not representable after negation and can yield overflow or a nonpositive seed.
The POSIX usleep routine is declared as a C-interoperable subroutine even though the C API returns an integer status, so the binding does not match the external function's prototype.
myusleep does not reject negative durations and applies backend-dependent coercion, while the Intel/PGI paths also force zero or sub-millisecond requests to sleep at least one millisecond.
